How to play
How to play

Win at 10 points.

Each turn: roll. Matching numbers pay goods from tiles you touch. On a seven, anyone with more than seven goods discards half. Move and block a hex; the wayfarer takes a card from an adjacent seat. Blocked land pays nothing.

Build paths (wood + brick), outposts (wood, brick, sheep, wheat), strongholds (three wheat, two stone). Fortunes cost sheep, wheat, stone.

Outposts score 1, strongholds 2. Longest path of five and largest army of three wayfarer cards score 2 more. Docks cut bank trade to 3:1 or 2:1.

Drag to orbit the isle. Tap glowing corners and paths to build.
